title.en: Restore the separate subscribed-course Reading entry
title.zh: 恢复订阅课程的独立阅读入口

purpose.en: Close the production navigation defect found during the four-language matrix: the Reading URL loaded the default five-skill view because the course menu and route mapping omitted Reading.
purpose.zh: 修复四语生产矩阵发现的导航缺陷：课程菜单及路由映射漏掉阅读，导致阅读 URL 打开默认五技能视图。

en: Expose Reading as its own course training tile alongside vocabulary, speaking, listening, writing, and quiz.
Map training=reading to the existing Reading tab in the server-rendered learning session.
Preserve the same database-authoritative daily task, grading, checkpoint, and Continue flow.
zh: 在词汇、口语、听力、写作和测验旁新增独立的课程阅读训练 tile。
将 training=reading 映射到服务器渲染学习会话中已有的阅读标签。
保持同一数据库权威的每日任务、判分、断点及继续流程。

en: Signed-in subscribed-course training navigation for all course languages; no Clerk, payment, administrator, sibling-site, or anonymous learning behavior.
zh: 所有课程语言的登录订阅课程训练导航；不影响 Clerk、支付、管理员、兄弟站点或匿名学习行为。

en: Add a bilingual Reading tile to the course training menu.
Recognize the Reading query in the signed-in session page's initial-skill mapping.
Add regression coverage for both the visible entry and route-to-tab contract.
zh: 在课程训练菜单新增双语阅读 tile。
在登录学习会话页的初始技能映射中识别阅读查询参数。
为可见入口及路由到标签合同增加回归覆盖。

en: Run the course-entry regression contract, TypeScript, the complete automated suite, D1 migration validation, sensitive-data scan, production-equivalent build, changed-file lint, and shared portfolio gates.
Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then use the ordinary test learner to enter Spanish and Italian Reading directly and complete a real graded item.
zh: 执行课程入口回归合同、TypeScript、全量自动化、D1 迁移、敏感数据扫描、生产等价构建、修改文件 lint 与共享组合门禁。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布到 Cloudflare，再由普通测试学员直接进入西语、意语阅读并完成真实判分。

en: The remaining en/ja/es/it real-learning matrix and observable normal-versus-slow audio timing require the fresh Terra production retest after this deployment.
zh: 剩余英/日/西/意真实学习矩阵及可观察的正常/慢速音频时长，需要在本次发布后由 Terra 重新执行生产验收。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's existing database authority, Repeat After Me default-off behavior, GitHub-to-Cloudflare delivery, and SmartLingo-only data boundaries.
Do not modify any other site, account, credential, payment rail, database binding, or cloud resource.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 既有数据库权威、跟读默认关闭、GitHub 至 Cloudflare 发布及仅限 SmartLingo 的数据边界。
不修改其他站点、账户、凭据、支付通道、数据库绑定或云资源。
